evidenceClass: target2016 declarations + existing Web Time Ring owner validation adaptation

timeRing.description:
Reduces the skill cooldown time of all party members within range and applies the [Time Traveler] buff.

#CFFC000Time Traveler#CX
- Records the current HP/MP/DP/Way of the Sword/NF/Cannon Ball/Energy/Mutation Point
- If a player is defeated during the duration of the skill, they are resurrected with the same status as the recorded point in time.
- This ability has top priority over other resurrection skills.
- PVP only record 50% of Maximum HP
- If a player is resurrected with the [Time Traveler] buff, they will have the [Time Sickness] debuff for 120 seconds.
- Cooldown Reduction is not applied to Hyper/Wedding/Seal of Time skills.

#C4488FFDP Skill#CX
- Dynamo Configuration Mode (Awakening) consumes DP and not MP
